Kerala to study backwardness, faces mounting revenue arrears

The Kerala government has announced the formation of a commission to study the reasons for backwardness in specific areas and communities, with plans for resource allocation for development. This initiative comes as a Comptroller and Auditor General's report indicates significant revenue arrears, amounting to ₹41,188.44 crore, which represents a substantial portion of the state's own revenue. Another report flags a total debt of ₹4.85 lakh crore facing the new government.
